source: Daija approved this menu, prices included, on 2026-09-06. priceSource says where each number came from: 'hers' = a price she gave us herself or published on one of her own menus; 'market' = a Philadelphia going rate we set and she then signed off on. The infused butter and oil is $75 on her own instruction - she raised it from the $35 we had guessed. The Shroom items are her own 2021 dessert-menu prices, transcribed in research/menu-extracted.md section 2C, and she approved putting them back on the menu. Full record in docs/price-sheet.md.

sections.title: The Add-On
sections.heading: It is an add-on, not a separate kitchen
sections.note: She makes her own infused butter and cooks with it, so most of The Kitchen menu can be made infused. Strength is set per order - tell her what you are used to and she will match it.

items.name: Any Dish, Infused
items.desc: Add to any plate on The Kitchen menu. Price is on top of the dish. Tell her the strength you want.

items.name: Infused Butter or Oil
items.desc: The base she cooks with, made by her. One product, two forms - say butter or say oil when you order. Same price either way, and the oil is not an upgrade. A batch runs about 4oz; she works to the same weight whichever form you pick.

sections.title: What She Already Makes
sections.heading: The ones she makes most
sections.note: These are the infused dishes she has posted, and the ones people come back for.

items.name: Infused Garlic Parm Wings
items.desc: Her garlic parm wings, infused. One of her most-watched videos.
items.alt: Golden garlic parmesan wings dusted with cheese and parsley in a foil tray

items.name: Infused Buffalo Chicken Dip
items.desc: The buffalo chicken dip, infused. Made to order, sized for a group.

sections.title: The Shroom Menu
sections.heading: Shrooms - a separate menu
sections.note: These are mushroom items, not cannabis. They have nothing to do with the infused butter above and they are not made with it. They come off her own 2021 dessert menu, at her own prices.

items.desc: Her chocolate bar, whole. Straight off her own dessert menu.
